title: 第七章 骨裂锥心血染石第八章 混沌微光初入体
content_zh:
“吼——！！！”
通道深处那饱含暴戾与饥饿的恐怖咆哮，如同实质的音波巨锤，狠狠砸在楚夜的耳膜和心脏上！整个洞窟都在簌簌发抖，碎石如雨点般落下，砸在冰冷的地面和寒潭中，溅起片片水花！浓郁的血腥气和令人作呕的腥臊恶风，如同粘稠的潮水，瞬间灌满了整个空间，几乎让人窒息！
来了！那盘踞在黑风崖底的恐怖凶兽，被巨石喷薄的生命精气彻底激怒，正以摧枯拉朽之势撞碎一切阻碍，直扑而来！
楚夜浑身的汗毛瞬间炸起！刚刚因磅礴生机灌注而充满力量的身体，在这恐怖的凶煞威压下，竟本能地感到一阵僵硬和冰冷！他猛地回头，目光死死锁住那漆黑深邃的通道入口，眼中再无半分狂喜，只剩下如临大敌的凝重和冰冷刺骨的杀意！
柳氏刚刚恢复一丝血色的脸瞬间变得煞白，眼中充满了极致的恐惧，虚弱地抓住楚夜的胳膊：“夜…夜儿…那…那是什么…”
“娘！别怕！躲到我身后！千万别出来！”楚夜的声音斩钉截铁，带着一种不容置疑的力量。他猛地将柳氏往自己身后一推，让她紧紧贴在那块散发着恐怖气息的斑驳石壁下方，自己则如同磐石般挡在通道与母亲之间！同时，他眼角的余光死死盯住中央那块仍在喷涌乳白精气的巨石裂缝——那是娘亲续命的根本！绝不能被破坏！
轰隆！咔嚓！
通道入口处，一块半人高的巨大岩石，如同豆腐般被一股蛮横到极致的力量撞得粉碎！烟尘弥漫中，一个庞大到令人窒息的恐怖黑影，带着一股毁灭性的飓风，猛地冲入了洞窟！
嘶——！
饶是楚夜早有心理准备，看清这凶兽的瞬间，也不由得倒抽一口冷气！
那东西根本不像凡间应有的生灵！它身高接近一丈，形似巨猿，但浑身覆盖的不是毛发，而是一片片巴掌大小、闪烁着幽冷金属光泽的厚重黑鳞！鳞片缝隙间，流淌着暗红色的、如同岩浆般粘稠的诡异液体，散发出灼热的高温和浓烈的血腥气！它的头颅狰狞无比，獠牙外翻，如同两柄弯曲的骨刀，一双灯笼大小的赤红巨眼，里面燃烧着纯粹的暴戾、贪婪和毁灭欲望，死死地锁定了洞窟中央那块喷薄生命精气的巨石！
“黑…黑鳞暴猿？！”一个几乎被遗忘在记忆角落的、云州城流传的古老凶兽名字，瞬间蹦入楚夜的脑海！传说这怪物力大无穷，鳞甲刀枪不入，口喷毒火，喜食生灵精血，是黑风崖底真正的霸主！眼前这头，气息之恐怖，远超传说！
“吼——！！！”
黑鳞暴猿显然也看到了巨石裂缝中喷涌的生命精气，那双赤红巨眼中的贪婪瞬间暴涨到了极致！它发出一声更加震耳欲聋的咆哮，粗壮如石柱的前肢猛地拍击地面！
轰！！！
整个洞窟如同遭遇地震般剧烈摇晃！地面坚硬的岩石被拍出一个巨大的蛛网状深坑！狂暴的气浪裹挟着碎石，如同炮弹般四散射开！
楚夜瞳孔骤缩！这力量…太恐怖了！远超他此刻的状态！但他不能退！身后是娘亲！是续命的希望！
“畜生！滚开！”楚夜发出一声暴喝，强行压下心头的惊骇，眼中凶光爆射！混沌道骨刚刚吸收的磅礴生命精气在体内疯狂运转，一股灼热的力量瞬间充斥四肢百骸！他脚下猛地一蹬，坚硬的地面被踏出裂纹，身体如同离弦之箭，主动朝着那恐怖巨兽冲了过去！不是硬撼，而是试图引开它的注意力！
他的目标，是暴猿相对脆弱的、没有鳞甲覆盖的腹部和关节！
然而，黑鳞暴猿的智慧显然不低！它那赤红的巨眼只是轻蔑地扫了冲来的楚夜一眼，仿佛在看一只扑火的飞蛾！它庞大的身躯竟异常灵活地一个侧身，那条覆盖着厚重鳞片、末端带着尖锐骨刺的恐怖长尾，如同一条巨大的钢鞭，撕裂空气，带着刺耳的尖啸，以雷霆万钧之势，狠狠抽向楚夜！

速度太快！力量太猛！角度太刁钻！
楚夜只来得及将双臂交叉护在胸前，混沌之力本能地运转到双臂！
砰——！！！
一声沉闷到令人牙酸的巨响！
楚夜感觉自己像是被一座高速移动的山峰迎面撞上！双臂传来一阵令人牙酸的骨裂声！剧痛瞬间淹没神经！那狂暴的巨力透过双臂，狠狠撞在他的胸膛上！
“噗——！”一大口滚烫的鲜血狂喷而出！楚夜的身体如同断了线的风筝，被这恐怖的一尾鞭抽得凌空飞起，狠狠撞向洞窟侧壁！
轰隆！
坚硬的岩壁被撞得碎石崩飞！楚夜的身体深深嵌了进去，又重重摔落在地，溅起一片尘埃！他眼前阵阵发黑，五脏六腑仿佛都移了位，双臂软软垂下，骨头不知断了多少根！胸腹间气血翻腾，每一次呼吸都带着浓重的血腥味和撕裂般的剧痛！
仅仅一击！就让他重伤濒死！这凶兽的力量，完全碾压他！
“夜儿！！！”柳氏发出撕心裂肺的尖叫，挣扎着想扑过来。
“别过来！”楚夜用尽力气嘶吼，又是一口血涌出。他挣扎着想爬起来，但剧痛和巨大的力量差距带来的无力感，几乎将他吞噬。
黑鳞暴猿根本没把楚夜这只“小虫子”放在眼里。它击飞楚夜后，赤红的巨眼便贪婪地锁定了中央巨石那道喷涌生命精气的裂缝！它发出一声兴奋的咆哮，庞大的身躯带着地动山摇的气势，迈开沉重的步伐，朝着巨石狂奔而去！每一步落下，地面都在震颤！
“不！！”楚夜目眦欲裂！巨石一旦被毁，娘亲必死无疑！他挣扎着，用还能动的左臂撑着地面，试图再次爬起，但断裂的右臂和胸腹的剧痛让他根本无法发力！
眼看那黑鳞暴猿的巨爪就要拍向巨石——
嗡！！！
就在这时，楚夜后背紧贴着的、那块布满诡异暗红纹路的斑驳石壁，突然毫无征兆地发出了一声低沉而苍凉的嗡鸣！
这嗡鸣声并不响亮，却带着一种难以言喻的穿透力和威压，瞬间压过了暴猿的咆哮和洞窟的震颤！仿佛沉睡了万古的存在，被外界的喧嚣和能量波动所惊扰！
石壁表面那些如同凝固血液般的暗红纹路，在中央巨石生命精气的持续映照下，如同活物般猛地亮了起来！光芒流转，那些扭曲的藤蔓、断裂的锁链、混沌的漩涡线条…开始以一种极其复杂、难以理解的方式加速蠕动、变幻！一股比中央巨石更加古老、更加混乱、更加令人心悸的法则气息，如同苏醒的史前巨兽，轰然弥漫开来！
这股气息，带着一种至高无上的、破碎的、却又蕴含着某种本源意蕴的威压，瞬间笼罩了整个洞窟！
狂奔中的黑鳞暴猿，动作猛地一滞！它那赤红的巨眼中，第一次流露出了人性化的、极其强烈的惊疑和…一丝源自灵魂深处的恐惧！它似乎对这股突然出现的、更加古老恐怖的气息极其忌惮，庞大的身躯硬生生停在了距离巨石不足三丈的地方，焦躁不安地低吼着，赤红的眼睛警惕地在巨石和斑驳石壁之间逡巡，竟不敢再轻易上前！
content_en:
"Roar——!!!"
The terrifying roar full of violence and hunger deep in the passage was like a substantial sonic hammer, hitting Chu Ye's eardrums and heart hard! The entire cave was trembling, and gravel fell like raindrops, hitting the cold ground and the cold pool, causing splashes of water! The rich smell of blood and the disgusting smelly wind, like a thick tide, instantly filled the entire space, almost making people suffocate!
Coming! The terrifying ferocious beast entrenched at the bottom of the Black Wind Cliff was completely enraged by the life essence spurting from the boulder. It was crushing all obstacles with overwhelming force and charging straight towards it!
The hair all over Chu Ye's body suddenly exploded! The body that had just been filled with strength due to the infusion of majestic vitality instinctively felt stiff and cold under the terrifying pressure of the evil! He turned back suddenly, his eyes locked on the entrance of the dark and deep passage. There was no trace of ecstasy in his eyes, only the solemnity of facing a powerful enemy and the cold and piercing killing intent!
Liu's face, which had just regained some color, instantly turned pale, her eyes filled with extreme fear, and she weakly grabbed Chu Ye's arm: "Ye...Ye'er...then...what is that..."
"Mom! Don't be afraid! Hide behind me! Don't come out!" Chu Ye's voice was decisive, with an unquestionable power. He suddenly pushed Mrs. Liu behind him, making her cling tightly to the bottom of the mottled stone wall that exuded a terrifying aura, while he stood between the passage and his mother like a rock! At the same time, the corner of his eye was fixed on the crack in the huge stone in the center that was still spewing milky white essence - that was the basis for his mother's continued life! Must not be destroyed!
Boom! Click!
At the entrance of the passage, a huge rock half a man's height was smashed into pieces like tofu by an extremely arrogant force! In the smoke and dust, a huge and suffocating terrifying black shadow rushed into the cave with a devastating hurricane!
hiss--!
Even though Chu Ye had been mentally prepared, the moment he saw the ferocious beast clearly, he couldn't help but gasp!
That thing doesn't look like a living being in the mortal world at all! It is nearly one foot tall and looks like a giant ape, but its body is not covered with hair, but thick black scales the size of a palm, shining with a cold metallic luster! Between the gaps between the scales, a dark red, strange liquid as thick as magma flows, exuding scorching heat and a strong bloody smell! Its head was extremely ferocious, its fangs were turned outwards, like two curved bone knives, and a pair of huge red eyes the size of lanterns, burning with pure violence, greed and desire for destruction, locked firmly on the boulder in the center of the cave that was spewing out life essence!
"Black... black-scaled violent ape?!" The name of an ancient ferocious beast circulated in Yunzhou City, almost forgotten in the corner of his memory, instantly popped into Chu Ye's mind! Legend has it that this monster is extremely powerful, has invulnerable scales, spits poisonous fire from its mouth, and likes to feed on the essence and blood of living beings. It is the real overlord at the bottom of the Black Wind Cliff! The aura in front of me is terrifying, far beyond the legend!
"Roar——!!!"
The black-scaled violent ape obviously also saw the life essence spurting out from the cracks in the boulder, and the greed in his giant red eyes suddenly surged to the extreme! It let out an even more deafening roar, and its forelimbs, as thick as stone pillars, slammed onto the ground!
boom! ! !
The entire cave shook violently as if it was experiencing an earthquake! A huge spider web-shaped pit was photographed on the hard rock on the ground! The violent air waves carried the gravel and scattered it like cannonballs!
Chu Ye's pupils shrank suddenly! This power... is so terrifying! Far beyond his current state! But he can't retreat! Behind me is my mother! It is the hope of continued life!
"Beast! Get away!" Chu Ye shouted violently, suppressing the fear in his heart, and a fierce light burst out in his eyes! The majestic life essence that the Chaos Dao Bone had just absorbed was running wildly in the body, and a searing power instantly filled the limbs and bones! He kicked his feet violently, causing cracks in the hard ground. His body was like an arrow leaving the string.He rushed towards the terrifying beast! It's not about trying to force it, but trying to distract it!
His target is the relatively fragile abdomen and joints of the violent ape that are not covered by scales!
However, the intelligence of the black-scaled violent ape is obviously not low! Its huge red eyes just glanced at the rushing Chu Ye with contempt, as if looking at a moth flying into the flames! Its huge body turned sideways with extraordinary flexibility. The terrifying long tail covered with thick scales and with sharp bone spurs at the end was like a huge steel whip, tearing the air, with an ear-piercing scream, and whipped towards Chu Ye with thunderous force!
Too fast! The power is too strong! The angle is too tricky!
Chu Ye only had time to cross his arms in front of his chest to protect him, and the power of chaos instinctively moved to his arms!
Bang--! ! !
A loud noise that was so dull that it made your teeth hurt!
Chu Ye felt as if he was hit head-on by a high-speed mountain peak! There was a heartbreaking sound of bone cracking coming from both arms! The severe pain instantly overwhelmed the nerves! The violent force passed through his arms and hit his chest hard!
"Puff——!" A large mouthful of hot blood spurted out! Chu Ye's body was like a kite with its strings broken. It was whipped by this terrifying tail whip and flew into the air, slamming into the side wall of the cave!
Boom!
The hard rock wall was hit and the rocks flew away! Chu Ye's body was deeply embedded, and he fell heavily to the ground, splashing a cloud of dust! His eyes were turning black, his internal organs seemed to be out of place, his arms were hanging limply, and he had no idea how many bones were broken! Qi and blood surged between the chest and abdomen, and every breath carried a strong smell of blood and a tearing pain!
Just one blow! Let him be seriously injured and on the verge of death! The power of this ferocious beast completely crushed him!
"Ye'er!!!" Ms. Liu let out a heartbreaking scream, struggling to pounce on her.
"Don't come here!" Chu Ye screamed with all his strength, and another mouthful of blood gushed out. He struggled to get up, but the severe pain and the feeling of powerlessness caused by the huge power gap almost swallowed him up.
The black-scaled violent ape didn't take this "little bug" Chu Ye seriously at all. After it knocked Chu Ye away, its giant red eyes greedily locked on the crack in the central boulder that spewed life essence! It let out an excited roar, and with its huge body carrying the momentum of shaking the earth, it took heavy steps and ran towards the boulder! With every step, the ground trembles!
"No!!" Chu Ye's eyes were about to burst! Once the boulder is destroyed, my mother will definitely die! He struggled, supporting the ground with his still movable left arm, and tried to get up again, but the severe pain in his broken right arm and chest and abdomen made it impossible for him to exert any strength!
Seeing that the huge claws of the black-scaled ape were about to hit the boulder——
Buzz! ! !
At this moment, the mottled stone wall covered with strange dark red lines that Chu Ye's back was pressing against suddenly let out a low and desolate buzz without any warning!
The buzzing sound was not loud, but it carried an indescribable penetrating power and pressure, instantly overwhelming the roar of the violent ape and the tremors of the cave! It seems like an existence that has been sleeping for eternity is disturbed by the noise and energy fluctuations from the outside world!
The dark red lines on the surface of the stone wall, which looked like coagulated blood, suddenly lit up like living creatures under the continuous illumination of the life essence of the central boulder! As the light flows, those twisted vines, broken chains, chaotic vortex lines... begin to accelerate and change in an extremely complex and incomprehensible way! An aura of law that is older, more chaotic, and more heart-stopping than the central boulder, like an awakening prehistoric beast, suddenly spreads out!
This breath, with a supreme, broken, but containing some kind of original meaning, instantly enveloped the entire cave!
The running black-scaled violent ape suddenly stopped moving! For the first time, its giant red eyes showed humanized and extremely strong suspicion and... a hint of fear from the depths of its soul! It seemed to react to this sudden,The more ancient and terrifying aura was extremely fearful. The huge body stopped abruptly less than three feet away from the boulder, growling restlessly. His red eyes patrolled between the boulder and the mottled stone wall vigilantly, not daring to move forward easily!
